bitcoin_articles.headline: Sphere 3D and Cathedra Bitcoin Provide Update on Proposed Business Combination
bitcoin_articles.summary: Sphere 3D Corp. and Cathedra Bitcoin Inc. issued a joint update confirming that their previously announced business combination remains on track to close in the near term, subject to customary conditions.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Bitdeer Reports Mining and Sale of 193.8 BTC for the Week Ending May 8, 2026
bitcoin_articles.summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group announced the production and immediate sale of 193.8 BTC for the week ending May 8, 2026, maintaining its zero-treasury strategy.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Quantum Blockchain Technologies Revives Quantum Computing Research for Bitcoin Mining
bitcoin_articles.summary: Quantum Blockchain Technologies PLC has restarted its quantum computing research program focused on improving Bitcoin mining efficiency.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Cango Inc. Announces April 2026 Operational and Fleet Optimization Update
bitcoin_articles.summary: Cango Inc. reported its April 2026 operational results, highlighting the production of 230.04 Bitcoin and a total treasury holding of 1,057.46 Bitcoin.
